notes: `שָׂבַע יָמִים` → *full of days*: the *of* stays with `שָׂבַע`, whose English predicate *full* admits no other word before a bare complement, exactly as rule 33's closing paragraph reads `מָלֵא דָשֶׁן` → *full of fatness*. The competing reading gives the *of* to `יָמִים` as an adverbial accusative's own case-function word.
`יַּמְלֵךְ` → *made ... king* is read as light verb plus complement under rule 44, discontinuous around the object under rule 25.
